Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independently painted 2D game character portrait plus separate specialty object, one Zaun commander for original 1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III. This must be a finished painted bitmap master, not a 3D render.
Composition: landscape1536x1024. LEFT square1024x1024 holds ONE close head-and-shoulders portrait, full head center near x512, face occupies central 600 pixels. RIGHT512x1024 panel one separate specialty object fully contained x1100..1480 y250..800, on dark umber. Exact vertical panel boundary1024. No text/labels/border/watermark, no second character.
Rendering language: match supplied ORIGINAL HoMM3 portrait reference's compact realistic face, sculpted painted facial planes, directional upper-left warm light, strong value separation, slightly rough oil-painted metal/leather/cloth, restrained highlights; readable at58x64 and48x32. The original reference is style only; do not reproduce any of its faces. Official LoR image supplies character anatomy/clothing cues only; do NOT copy its scene or pose. Independently paint the new close portrait. Not anime, comic outlines, stylized cartoon, glossy contemporary game art, plastic, photoreal photo, splash art, flat vector, arbitrary pixelation or filters. Genuine painted2D only.
Subject and separate object: CORINA VERAZA, named Zaun chem-baron horticulturist. Human woman with medium brown skin, narrow expressive eyes, arched brows, confident calculating expression, dark brown swept-back hair gathered low with a curled side lock; thin articulated silver augmentation plates from her left lower cheek down side of neck, not a full mask. Dark fitted bodice with ochre high petal-shaped shoulder collar, tiny purple cloth accent; no crown. Her cultivair greenhouse is subdued behind her. Specialty object: one glass-stoppered bulbous alchemist reagent bottle containing sulphur-yellow crystals and a single purple flower sprig beside it. This illustrates bounded sulphur income, not an army poison power.
